title: Bissell returns to the CIA after his ouster

tellings.quote: In Bissell's case, the rumor was he left work at the CIA on Friday and on Monday he returned because he was too indispensable to certain [music] activities he was involved in.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Richard Bissell, a senior official at the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, who was pushed out around 1961. Michels says the rumor was that Bissell left work at CIA headquarters in Langley, Virginia, on a Friday and was back on Monday, because he was too indispensable to certain secret activities. Michels raises it while asking whether a hidden program to recover crashed UFOs existed, since it would suggest such work went on out of sight.
